title: Your Judge Inherits Your Prompt: In-Context Label Bias in an LLM-as-Judge Is Directional, Not Symmetric
abstract: arXiv:2611.26881v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-as-judge has become a standard way to score open-ended model outputs, yet the judge is itself a frozen language model steered by a few in-context examples, and such models are known to absorb the label balance of their demonstrations rather than treat them as neutral illustrations. We ask whether this label bias reaches an LLM judge used inside a multimodal (video question answering) evaluation pipeline, and what form it takes. Using a fully frozen generator-judge pipeline, we hold the generated answers fixed and vary only the Yes/No balance of the judge's few-shot examples across four demonstration sets. Each verdict is validated against a two-annotator human consensus on 200 examples per dataset. translated_title: 你的评审器会继承你的提示词：LLM即评审中的上下文标签偏置是有方向性的，而非对称的
translated_abstract: LLM-as-judge（以大语言模型作为评审器）已成为对开放式模型输出进行评分的标准方法，然而评审器本身是一个由少量上下文示例引导的冻结语言模型，而此类模型已知会吸收其演示示例中的标签分布，而非将其视为中性的示例。我们探究这种标签偏置是否会传导到多模态（视频问答）评估流水线中使用的LLM评审器，以及它以何种形式呈现。通过使用完全冻结的生成器-评审器流水线，我们保持生成的答案不变，仅在四个演示集之间改变评审器少样本示例的Yes/No（是/否）平衡。每个判定结果均与每个数据集200个样本上的双人标注人类共识进行对照验证。当评审器的示例为平衡或偏向拒绝时，其接受率保持接近人类共识；但当示例偏向接受时，接受率急剧跳升（在NExT-QA上约30个百分点，在MSVD-QA上约20个百分点，且呈现强烈单侧的错误特征）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 研究表明，多模态视频问答评估流水线中的LLM评审器会从其少样本示例中单向继承标签偏置：当示例偏向"Yes"时其接受率骤升约20–30个百分点并伴随单侧错误，而当示例平衡或偏向"No"时则接近人类共识，证明这种上下文标签偏置是方向性的而非对称的。
en_tdlr: An LLM judge inherits directional, not symmetric, label bias from its few-shot examples: skewing demonstrations toward "Yes" sharply inflates acceptance rates (~30 points on NExT-QA, ~20 on MSVD-QA) with strongly one-sided errors, while balanced or rejection-skewed examples keep the judge close to human consensus.
